in_marathi.name: Harita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harita is a Sanskrit word derived from the root word 'hari' meaning 'green' or 'fertile'. In Hindu mythology, Harita is the name of a goddess associated with fertility and growth. She is often depicted as the wife of Vayu, the god of wind.
